test.title: 🧪 Check script syntax
test.description: Runs node --check on every content script and the options page. The project has no automated tests.
test.command: for f in src/*.js options/options.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done

build chrome.title: 🔨 Build store zip
build chrome.description: Packages the extension into dist/github-carousel-<version>.zip for the Chrome Web Store.

release chrome.title: 🚀 Publish to Chrome Web Store
release chrome.description: Builds the zip, uploads it with the Chrome Web Store API and submits it for review. Bump the manifest version first.
